title: Polish Pancakes with Crumbly Topping
description: A classic Polish dessert featuring thick pancakes topped with a crumbly mixture of knotty ingredients
instructions: 2. Make the Polish pastry dough according to package instructions.
3. In a large bowl, combine the flour, grated banana, and brown sugar.
4. Add the eggs to the bowl and mix until a smooth batter forms.
5. Pour the batter into a greased 8-inch round cake pan.
6. Bake the pancakes for 20-25 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean.
7. Meanwhile, mix together the knotty almond flour and crumbly oatmeal in a small bowl.
8. Once the pancakes are done, top them with the crumbly mixture.
